title: An integer multiplicity current carried by the n-skeleton is a finite sum of integer densities on open faces (Simon (26)–(28), (33))
statement: Assume as hypotheses (VO), (MR) and (IMC), exactly as in the selected theorem. (VO): a current vanishes on test forms whose support is disjoint from its support. (MR): M_W(T) = R.measure(W) for open W when the IMRep R represents T on an open U. (IMC): (a) locality of approximate tangent spaces; (b) restricting an IMRep to a Borel set gives an IMRep that represents some current; (c) differences of integer multiplicity currents are integer multiplicity; (d) |R.orient(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for Hⁿ-a.e. x in the carrier. Let P, m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, let K ⊆ Euclid P be compact, and let Q₀ ∈ 𝒟_n(Euclid P) (domain univ) be integer multiplicity with spt Q₀ ⊆ K and spt Q₀ ⊆ L_n := {x : ∃ s, P ≤ n + |s|, x_i ∈ ℤ for i ∈ s}. Then there are a finite set s of index pairs p = (ι, b), with ι : Fin n → Fin P and b : Fin P → ℤ, and functions u_p : Euclid n → ℝ such that the following hold for every p ∈ s: ι is strictly increasing; u_p(y) ∈ ℤ for every y; u_p is integrable on Q₁ = (0,1)ⁿ; and Φ_p(y) ∈ spt Q₀ for some y ∈ [0,1]ⁿ, where Φ_p(y) := b + Σ_j y_j e_{ι(j)}. Moreover ENNReal.ofReal(Σ_{p∈s} ∫_{Q₁}|u_p|) ≤ M(Q₀), and Q₀(ω) = Σ_{p∈s} ∫_{Q₁} u_p(y) ω(Φ_p y)(e_{ι(0)}, …, e_{ι(n−1)}) dy for every test n-form ω.
